item.title: Aside from rate increase, Virginia HVAC expert offers insight on rising energy bills
item.description: Many Virginia residents have been shocked by their December and January energy bills, which have been three to four times higher than usual following the recent deep freeze.

item.title: She lost her brother to gun violence. Now, she's helping kids process grief through a children's book.
item.description: A Chesterfield woman shattered by her brother's murder has turned her grief into a lifeline for children struggling to understand violence.

item.title: Legacy of young basketball star Jaylen Martinez honored through memorial games
item.description: Several of Jaylen Martinez's coaches hosted a basketball game series called the "Biggest Apples All Star Games" in his memory, alongside his mother, Ciera.
